_comment: EP02 final (2026-11-24 15:39 brief): v2 plus a closing recap that shows the Renukacharya line alone over the sage, then cuts to the stone for the inscription line. The stone is an illustration, so it carries ప్రతీకాత్మక చిత్రం wherever it is on screen.

assets.S01: Temple hall at night; two worshippers with joined hands face the glowing sanctum doorway.
assets.S02: The sage stands in the glowing sanctum doorway; worshippers below raise joined hands.
assets.S03: Villagers at the temple doorway at night, looking in with wonder.
assets.S07: Wooded mountain at dusk; a thatched ashram hut and a fire pit.
assets.S08: Agastya, seated on a deer skin, sees the sage and rises with joined hands.
assets.S09: Lopamudra hands the brass water vessel to Agastya, lets go and steps back.
assets.S10: Agastya kneels, pours water over the guest's feet, sets the vessel down and washes them by hand.
assets.S11: Inside the hut: Agastya, open hand raised, faces the seated sage; Lopamudra behind.
assets.S12: The sage raises his hand and speaks; Agastya listens with joined palms; Lopamudra behind.
assets.S14: Temple hall at night; the sage walks with his staff toward the glowing sanctum between villagers.
assets.S15: The sage walks into the sanctum light, becomes a glow and vanishes; the doorway stays empty.
assets.S16b: An illustrated inscribed stone slab in the temple courtyard (not a photograph of the 1067 inscription), marked ప్రతీకాత్మక చిత్రం.

segments.sees: Close on the sage's face and shoulders: ash marks on forehead and arms.
Rudraksha strands around the sage's neck.
His hand on the tall trident staff; tilt up to the trident.
The brass water pot in his other hand.
Wide: the sage in the doorway speaking over the worshippers; slow push in on him.
Close on the sage, his face in the top of frame; name card రేణుకాచార్యుడు below it.
Villagers again; the camera tilts up to the bright doorway.
segments.flag: Voice: he leaves through the sky for the Malaya mountain. Screen: villagers and the doorway; the departure itself is not shown.

segments.sees: Inside the hut: Agastya and the sage seated face to face; Lopamudra behind.
Push in on Agastya, open hand raised toward the sage: he asks.
Close on the sage, hand raised, eyes lifted: he begins to answer.
Agastya asking (question cards, one at a time).
Wide: the sage teaching, Agastya with joined palms, Lopamudra listening.

segments.flag: Voice: he stood before Someshwara and prayed. Screen: he walks toward the sanctum (minor).

segments.sees: Close on the sage in the glowing sanctum doorway; card: లింగం దగ్గర రేణుకాచార్యుడి కథ.
The illustrated inscription stone; card: క్రీ.శ. 1067 · పూజలకు దానం; mark ప్రతీకాత్మక చిత్రం.
